🎉 The S1 Creator Incentive Program winner list is officially announced!

Dear Lords and creators:

The Conquest of Nine Kingdoms S1 Creator Incentive Program has officially concluded!

During the event, we received many outstanding works from creators across different regions. From Lineup builds, strategy guides, and gameplay recordings, to strategy sharing and creative image & text posts, every piece showcased your understanding of the game and passion for creation. ❤️

Thank you to every creator who participated in this Creator Incentive Program!

After a comprehensive review of content, quality, and related performance data, we are now officially announcing the winners of this event:

🏆 Best Creation Award | Video

🥇 Rookie_xd

🎁 Reward: US$500 worth of Vouchers + Exclusive Title

🌟 Master Creator

• Grind Guide TH

• ynaland

• DIZNEW WARGAMING

• LipGaming

• Teacher + Gaming

• PKTGaming

• AkinOsS Gaming & Shop

• Mojo MMO

🎁 Reward: US$150 worth of Vouchers per creator

⚔️ Rising Star

• Piyawat Kongkachuichay

• Luận Bàn Tam Quốc Game - Kim Hạo

• ZAPPO_DAMIX

• Jong

• CONKRU

• Zero Zone 2

🎁 Reward: US$40 worth of Vouchers per creator

🎨 Best Creation Award | Image & Text

🏅 almostreal

🏅 Andrew Chong

🎁 Reward: US$300 worth of Vouchers per creator + Exclusive Title

🍀 Lucky Prize

• Đỗ Quốc Cường

• G'Phat Saengkham

• ZALKED

• Papi Gaming GGS

• Fews

• RTS Realtime Strategy Community - TH

• Ly Ju

🎁 Reward: US$20 worth of Vouchers per creator

🎊 Congratulations to all the creators above!

📢 Reward Distribution Notice

Rewards for this event will be distributed uniformly in-game, based on the in-game information you submitted in your registration form. They are expected to be delivered within 10 days after the winner list is announced. Please wait patiently and keep an eye on your in-game reward inbox.

If you have any questions about the winner list or reward distribution, you can contact us through:

• Facebook: Send a DM to the official Conquest of Nine Kingdoms Facebook page

• Discord: DM the official staff member @Nelson

If you need to change your reward delivery information, please contact the official staff member @Nelson on Discord. You must reach out within 3 days after this notice is posted; requests submitted after this period can no longer be processed.

Once again, thank you to all creators who participated in the S1 Creator Incentive Program! ❤️

Not appearing on this winner list does not mean your work is not good enough. We saw the dedication and passion behind every video, guide, battle report, and creative piece. However, award slots are limited, so not every outstanding work can receive a reward.

The S1 creative journey has come to an end, but the story of our creators continues! 🔥

body:
📢 Important Notice | OBT Facebook Lucky Draw Winners, Please Contact Us!

Dear Lords,

We previously announced the winners of the Conquest of Nine Kingdoms OBT Facebook Lucky Draw.

However, some winners have not enabled private messages, which means our official team is currently unable to contact them directly.

Therefore, if you are an OBT winner who has not yet been in contact with our official team, please contact us within 7 days of this notice being published and provide the required information according to our staff's instructions so we can arrange your reward.

📩 How to Contact Us:

• Facebook: Send a private message to the official Conquest of Nine Kingdoms Facebook Page

• Discord: Contact our official staff member @Nelson

⏰ Please make sure to contact us within 7 days of this notice being published.

If a winner does not contact us within the specified period, they will be considered to have forfeited their eligibility for the reward, and the reward will no longer be reserved.

If you know any of the winners on the list, please help us spread the word and remind them to contact us as soon as possible!

🔒 Security Reminder:

Our official staff will never ask for your account password, verification code, or any form of payment. Please be cautious of unofficial messages and potential scams.

Congratulations again to all our winners, and thank you for your continued support of Conquest of Nine Kingdoms! ❤️

Conquest of Nine Kingdoms Operations Team
